column1: # Transcode queue - TSV, one title per line:

# optional Library Dir is relative to media/video and defaults to
# movies/<Name>, i.e. media/video/movies/<Name>/<Name>.mkv. TV episodes set it:
# Pick the SOURCE by duration, not by filename - the main feature is NOT
# Get the canonical "Title (Year)" from Radarr rather than guessing, and
# match any directory that already exists on hestia EXACTLY (capitalisation
# included) or you will create a duplicate.
